name: Ricardo Alonso
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport started with a fascination for the vibrant liveries he saw on racing cars as a child. He honed his skills through a vocational program specializing in automotive refinishing, quickly mastering the intricacies of paint application and color matching. Before joining V8 Masters Racing, he worked for a custom car shop, where he developed a keen eye for detail and a passion for creating visually stunning designs.

At V8 Masters Racing, Ricardo is responsible for ensuring that all team vehicles are impeccably painted and maintained. He is meticulous in his work, using advanced techniques and materials to achieve a flawless finish. Ricardo is also always looking for ways to improve the paint process, experimenting with new coatings and application methods to enhance both the appearance and performance of the cars. His ambition is to eventually lead a team of paint specialists and contribute to the design of iconic racing liveries.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is of medium height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always wears gloves, even when not painting.
Has a small collection of miniature racing car models on his workbench.
Whistles classic Spanish songs while working.
